استأميت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْمَيْتُ (istaʔmaytu) /is.taʔ.maj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَى (istaʔmā)
# اِسْتَأْمَيْتَ (istaʔmayta) /is.taʔ.maj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَى (istaʔmā)
# اِسْتَأْمَيْتِ (istaʔmayti) /is.taʔ.maj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْمَى (istaʔmā)
